### [doc:refund-and-credit-policy#cold-or-damaged-food] Refund and Credit Policy / Cold or damaged food
If telemetry confirms the warming box fell below 57°C on arrival, or the customer reports damaged food with a photo, the affected items are refunded to the original payment method. Refunds for cold or damaged food do not require the customer to return the item.
Key line: "If telemetry confirms the warming box fell below 57°C on arrival, or the customer reports damaged food with a photo, the affected items are refunded to the original payment method."

### [doc:m2-service-manual#warming-box-heat-loss] SliceBot M2 and M3 Service Manual / Warming box heat loss
Symptom: the warming box loses more than 8°C during a delivery under 25 minutes. Most common cause on the M2 is a worn lid seal gasket at the hinge corner. Check the heater element only after the seal is confirmed good. Fix: replace the lid seal gasket (part LS-220). Repair time: 20 minutes. Skill: seal.
Key line: "Symptom: the warming box loses more than 8°C during a delivery under 25 minutes."

### [doc:OB-2026-014-m2-b07-lid-seal#summary] Ops Bulletin OB-2026-014: Lid seal wear on batch M2-B07 / Summary
Robots from manufacturing batch M2-B07 are showing early wear on the lid seal gasket. The gasket compresses at the hinge corner after roughly 1,500 lid cycles, letting heat escape during deliveries.
Key line: "The gasket compresses at the hinge corner after roughly 1,500 lid cycles, letting heat escape during deliveries."

### [doc:escalation-guidelines#what-a-good-handoff-contains] Escalation Guidelines / What a good handoff contains
A handoff must include the customer's request in one sentence, what was checked, what the agent recommends, and the policy that applies. The specialist should not need to ask the customer to repeat anything.

### [doc:refund-and-credit-policy#automatic-approval-limits] Refund and Credit Policy / Automatic approval limits
An AI agent may approve a credit or refund of up to $20.00 per order without human review. Any single refund or credit above $20.00, or more than one refund on the same order, must be approved by a Customer Care specialist. Agents must never split a larger refund into smaller ones to stay under the limit.

### [doc:OB-2026-014-m2-b07-lid-seal#action] Ops Bulletin OB-2026-014: Lid seal wear on batch M2-B07 / Action
Replace the lid seal gasket (part LS-220) on affected M2-B07 robots during off-peak hours. Do not ground robots during the dinner rush for this issue alone; it is a quality problem, not a safety problem. Refund cold-food complaints from affected robots under the standard policy.

### [doc:identity-verification#what-unverified-contacts-can-get] Identity Verification / What unverified contacts can get
Unverified contacts may receive general information, such as policies, delivery areas, and product guidance. They must not be told account details, order contents, addresses, or payment information, and no credits, refunds, or account changes may be made.

## Policy, manuals, and past cases

### [doc:refund-and-credit-policy#cold-or-damaged-food] Refund and Credit Policy / Cold or damaged food
If telemetry confirms the warming box fell below 57°C on arrival, or the customer reports damaged food with a photo, the affected items are refunded to the original payment method. Refunds for cold or damaged food do not require the customer to return the item.
Key line: "If telemetry confirms the warming box fell below 57°C on arrival, or the customer reports damaged food with a photo, the affected items are refunded to the original payment method."

### [doc:m2-service-manual#warming-box-heat-loss] SliceBot M2 and M3 Service Manual / Warming box heat loss
Symptom: the warming box loses more than 8°C during a delivery under 25 minutes. Most common cause on the M2 is a worn lid seal gasket at the hinge corner. Check the heater element only after the seal is confirmed good. Fix: replace the lid seal gasket (part LS-220). Repair time: 20 minutes. Skill: seal.
Key line: "Symptom: the warming box loses more than 8°C during a delivery under 25 minutes."

### [doc:OB-2026-014-m2-b07-lid-seal#summary] Ops Bulletin OB-2026-014: Lid seal wear on batch M2-B07 / Summary
Robots from manufacturing batch M2-B07 are showing early wear on the lid seal gasket. The gasket compresses at the hinge corner after roughly 1,500 lid cycles, letting heat escape during deliveries.
Key line: "The gasket compresses at the hinge corner after roughly 1,500 lid cycles, letting heat escape during deliveries."

### [doc:escalation-guidelines#what-a-good-handoff-contains] Escalation Guidelines / What a good handoff contains
A handoff must include the customer's request in one sentence, what was checked, what the agent recommends, and the policy that applies. The specialist should not need to ask the customer to repeat anything.

### [doc:refund-and-credit-policy#automatic-approval-limits] Refund and Credit Policy / Automatic approval limits
An AI agent may approve a credit or refund of up to $20.00 per order without human review. Any single refund or credit above $20.00, or more than one refund on the same order, must be approved by a Customer Care specialist. Agents must never split a larger refund into smaller ones to stay under the limit.

### [doc:OB-2026-014-m2-b07-lid-seal#action] Ops Bulletin OB-2026-014: Lid seal wear on batch M2-B07 / Action
Replace the lid seal gasket (part LS-220) on affected M2-B07 robots during off-peak hours. Do not ground robots during the dinner rush for this issue alone; it is a quality problem, not a safety problem. Refund cold-food complaints from affected robots under the standard policy.

### [doc:identity-verification#what-unverified-contacts-can-get] Identity Verification / What unverified contacts can get
Unverified contacts may receive general information, such as policies, delivery areas, and product guidance. They must not be told account details, order contents, addresses, or payment information, and no credits, refunds, or account changes may be made.
